dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: Our membership has expanded too fast. We have to think of a way to solve our expense problem as soon as we can...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you do...

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: Oh, a new face.

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Graffiti Alliance HQ... It might just look like a normal house, but still!

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: If you're looking for one or more of our members, I regret to inform you that a couple hundred of them are busy painting all over Natlan, while others are busy managing their lives.

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: They only visit HQ to pay membership fees, or when seeking out technical assistance.

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: Anyone from Natlan you see holding a spray can and paint bucket is probably one of ours.

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: If you want to visit, feel free to do so any time.

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: But you won't find any of our alliance members' exquisite masterpieces here — those are scattered all over Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Expenses?

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: A thousand Mora to each person each year — that's what goes into training up new members of our Alliance.

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: Outsiders have told us that art from other places attaches great importance to heritage.

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: So my master's master's master's... master from Archon-only-knows how many generations ago, that person created this membership fee system.

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: We put these dues toward buying lots of paints and spray paint tools so that we can give keen joiners free lessons...

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: That spread the popularity of graffiti and got more people into it.

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: However, the fees haven't changed for hundreds of years. Nowadays, it's not enough to cover our expenses.

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: Perhaps I could take some orders for portraits, earn some royalties, and beef up our expenses fund...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you to it, then!

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: You're too kind... If you need anything, come find me any time!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: May I join the alliance, too?

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: Sure. Henceforth, you're a member.

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: I'll note your name down later.

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: Don't look so surprised. There's no testing or ceremony for new entrants. So long as you're interested in graffiti, you can join up.

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: If you need any help, you can always ask your fellow alliance members.

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: Just remember to give us a shoutout to others once you're out there throwing up your mad masterpieces.
